info.name: Orbix School ERP API
info.description:
API collection for all Orbix custom Odoo 19 modules, including the full bxi_api_support surface (fees, fee exemptions, refunds, scholarships, attendance, assessments, academic management, lesson plans, timetable admin, RTE admission, certificates, announcements, notices, student onboarding, canteen, uniform, transport, health center and lab management), on top of the original bxi_api, bxi_identity_verification, bxi_library_book_request, bxi_notification_gateway, bxi_online_fee_payment, bxi_parent_data_api, bxi_parent_teacher_messaging, bxi_settings_api, bxi_system_logs_api and bxi_teacher_support surfaces.

Auth: call 'Login' in the Auth folder first - it saves the returned token into the {{token}} collection variable, which is used as a Bearer token on every other request via the collection-level Authorization. Update the id-like collection variables (student_id, exam_id, refund_id, ...) to point at real records in your database before running requests that use them.
